title: Kyiv comes under heavy Russian missile attack, killing at least 13
summary_full: Children’s hospital and residential areas hit in latest bombardment of capital and surrounding regionEurope live – latest updatesA heavy Russian bombardment has killed at least 13 people in Ukraine’s capital and its surrounding region overnight, authorities have said.A missile attack on Kyiv struck residential areas and warehouses, said the mayor, Vitali Klitschko. The attack damaged residential buildings, a medical facility and an educational institution. Thirteen people were killed and 33 injured, he said. Continue reading...
